claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM the compound is expected to inhibit the proteasome (PSMB1/20S catalytic subunit), producing a proteotoxic-stress cytotoxic pattern that is largely selective for hematologic and other proteasome-inhibitor-sensitive lineages rather than broad killing.
